system.description:
Requirements: Training (1) in Nature

You’re an experienced hunter and know how to track your prey.

  • You have Advantage on checks to track, find, or trap a creature.

  • You have Advantage on checks to identify tracks or other signs of passage as belonging to creatures that you are familiar with.

  • You may track creatures through circumstances that would normally be impossible (over rock, across a river, etc).

  • While traveling in the wilderness, you can always find a relatively secure place to rest (provided that one exists), and cannot be surprised while resting there.
